observation: Read all2782characters. Four substantive paragraphs move from a business-maturity motivation to assessment,to improvement,and then transfer across corporate scales/industries. Assessment decomposes people/technology/process into twelve KPIs,combines fuzzy evaluation with EWM-AHPscores,and maps the combined result to capability maturity. Improvement consumes those component scores as a maturity vector and seeks a target maturity surface before giving proposals;this is an explicit assessment-to-decision handoff. The final Scale-Demandmethod adjusts component importance for different corporations and discusses shared-model benefits. No concrete system score,optimization outcome or reliability statistic is reported in this summary;the final reliability check is mentioned only. Source spelling retained. Formula correctness,three-dimensional geometry and flow charts were not examined.
